title: Patient Financial Account — Refunds of Credit Balances to the Original Payer
content:
The credit refund is the amount of a Patient Financial Account's credit balance refunded to the payer of the payment that created the credit. It is settled when the patient asks for the credit to be refunded.

## Rule

A credit is refunded only after the charge whose check or ACH payment was most recently returned carries a card, HSA/FSA card or cash payment posted after that return. Where the ledger shows a returned check or ACH payment, the credit refund therefore waits until the charge the most recently returned one had been applied to shows a card, HSA/FSA card or cash payment dated after that return.

| Ledger on the handling date (hypothetical) | Credit may be refunded |
|---|---|
| a check returned on 4 May; the charge it had paid shows a card payment posted 9 May | yes |
| a check returned on 4 May; the charge it had paid shows only a check payment posted 9 May | not yet |
| a check returned on 4 May; the charge it had paid shows a cash payment posted 1 May, before the return | not yet |

The payment that created the credit is the most recently posted payment that brought the unreversed payments applied to a charge above that charge's amount, counting only charges to which no returned check or ACH payment was ever applied; the credit refund is issued as one refund entry against that payment and goes to that payment's own method, a cash payment being refunded by check.

## Tool: `issue_credit_refund_942b7f9f`

**Capability.** Refunds part or all of a credit balance on a Linden Ridge financial account to the payer of the payment that created it. One call records one refund entry of exactly the amount given, linked to the payment named and dated today, issued to that payment's own method (a cash payment is refunded by check). The account's balance moves up by the amount refunded, so a credit shrinks toward zero. The patient sees the refund on the ledger and, once processed, on the original card or bank account.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_credit_refund_942b7f9f` through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and calls it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `billing_account_id` | reference number of the patient's financial account, as read from the financial account lookup | identifier |
| `applies_to_txn_id` | reference number of the payment entry whose overpayment created the credit, as read from the account ledger lookup | identifier |
| `refund_amount_usd` | amount refunded | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt: `billing_txn_id` (reference number of the new refund entry), `billing_account_id` (the account refunded from), `applies_to_txn_id` (the payment whose credit is refunded), the amount (USD refunded, 2 decimals), `payment_method` (the method the refund is issued to), `txn_date` (refund date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance` (the account balance once the refund is posted, USD, 2 decimals, negative while a credit remains). The presence of `billing_txn_id` means the refund was issued.
